title: Proposing and Evaluating Measures
summary: Developing proposals, defining criteria, and evaluating likely effects and tradeoffs.
whyItMatters: A policy proposal becomes discussable when its goal, mechanism, cost, feasibility, distribution, and evaluation plan are explicit.

mentalModel.title: Goal, mechanism, effect
mentalModel.content: Explain how the proposed action is expected to produce the desired result.

mentalModel.title: Criteria before preference
mentalModel.content: Agree on effectiveness, feasibility, fairness, and side effects before ranking options.

ruleBlocks.title: Specify the measure
ruleBlocks.content: Name actor, action, target group, timeline, and resources.

ruleBlocks.title: Evaluate with shared criteria
ruleBlocks.content: Compare expected impact, cost, acceptance, enforceability, and equity.

ruleBlocks.title: Define how success will be measured
ruleBlocks.content: Set indicators, review timing, and adjustment conditions.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Die Maßnahme ließe sich umsetzen, wenn ...
Der Erfolg wäre daran zu messen, ob ...

examples.de: Ich schlage vor, Reparaturen steuerlich zu fördern, damit Produkte länger genutzt werden.
examples.en: I propose tax incentives for repairs so products are used longer.

examples.de: Die Maßnahme ließe sich schrittweise einführen, sofern ausreichend Beratung angeboten wird.
examples.en: The measure could be introduced gradually if sufficient advice is offered.

examples.de: Dem geringeren Verbrauch stehen zunächst höhere Investitionskosten gegenüber.
examples.en: Lower consumption is initially offset by higher investment costs.

commonMistakes.wrong: Propose a goal without a mechanism.
commonMistakes.correct: Explain who changes what and why that should work.

commonMistakes.reason: A measure can be effective but unfair.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies lifecycle impacts and structural constraints.
Passive alternatives express feasibility and obligation concisely.
